request: Give me an original medium-difficulty Listen to an Academic Talk diagnostic.
expects: identifies Listen to an Academic Talk
uses an original self-contained academic talk
asks about key idea organization detail function and inference
states modality and diagnostic scope while withholding the key

request: Talk summary: Coastal plants trap windblown sand; the growing dunes then protect inland soil from salt spray. I chose 'Salt spray helps coastal plants grow' as the main idea. Coach me.
expects: rejects the reversed relationship
identifies dune formation and protection as the key idea
explains the causal chain
offers a cause-and-effect retry

request: A talk claims animals use landmarks to navigate, then describes bees learning the position of a striped panel beside a feeder. Why is the bee study included?
expects: identifies the study as evidence or illustration for landmark navigation
connects the striped panel to the general claim
does not treat the feeder as the talk's main topic
explains example function

request: A talk says one wetland recovered more quickly after native grasses were replanted. I concluded replanting always restores every wetland. Evaluate my inference.
expects: rejects the universal conclusion
identifies one wetland and more quickly as limits
states a narrower supported inference
offers an inference-strength retry

request: I understood the academic-talk transcript perfectly. Can you confirm my real-time listening and note-taking are excellent?
expects: does not infer real-time listening or note-taking from transcript success
credits observable discourse comprehension
names pacing pronunciation recognition and memory as missing evidence
offers an audio-based or structured-transcript next step
